portableRegression.scope: Original file provenance, immutable clock/order/retraction checks and a DB-only chmod readonly copy reconstructed in another process, including a fresh explicit EGGSHELL_DATA_ROOT. The first subprocess set XDG_DATA_HOME, which Eggshell does not use; the independent subprocess explicitly fixes the actual data root.

scope: The original canonical-subject fixture uses checked manual support/coquotation/usage APIs.
